name: Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC.le_measureReal_pairKernel
doc:
**The PAC property on the kernel**: for every `θ`, the recommendation is `ε`-optimal with
probability at least `1 - δ` under `pairKernel A T θ`.

statement.conclusion: 1 - δ ≤ ((pairKernel A T) θ).real {p | simpleRegret 𝒳 θ ↑p.2 ≤ ε}

code:
/-- **The PAC property on the kernel**: for every `θ`, the recommendation is `ε`-optimal with
probability at least `1 - δ` under `pairKernel A T θ`. -/
lemma _root_.Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC.le_measureReal_pairKernel (hpac : IsPAC 𝒳 A ε δ)
    (hA : A.IsFixedBudget T) (θ : E) :
    1 - δ ≤ (pairKernel A T θ).real {p | simpleRegret 𝒳 θ p.2 ≤ ε}
proof:
:= by
  have hrun := A.isRun_runMeasure (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ)
  have hlaw := hrun.hasLaw_history_out_pairKernel hA
  have hpac' := hpac.le_measureReal_of_isRun hrun
  rw [← hlaw.measureReal_eq (p := fun p ↦ simpleRegret 𝒳 θ p.2 ≤ ε)
    (measurableSet_simpleRegret_le θ ε)]
  exact hpac'

name: Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC.integral_simpleRegret_pairKernel_le
doc:
**Expected regret of a PAC algorithm** under `pairKernel A T θ`: if the simple regret on the
instance `θ` is between `0` and `Z ≥ ε` on `𝒳`, then `E_θ[r] ≤ ε + (Z - ε) δ`.

binders.name: h0
binders.type: ∀ x ∈ 𝒳, 0 ≤ simpleRegret 𝒳 θ x

binders.name: hZ
binders.type: ∀ x ∈ 𝒳, simpleRegret 𝒳 θ x ≤ Z

statement.conclusion: ∫ (p : Hist Unit ↑𝒳 ℝ T × ↑𝒳), simpleRegret 𝒳 θ ↑p.2 ∂(pairKernel A T) θ ≤ ε + (Z - ε) * δ

code:
/-- **Expected regret of a PAC algorithm** under `pairKernel A T θ`: if the simple regret on the
instance `θ` is between `0` and `Z ≥ ε` on `𝒳`, then `E_θ[r] ≤ ε + (Z - ε) δ`. -/
lemma _root_.Learning.LinearBandit.IsPAC.integral_simpleRegret_pairKernel_le
    (hpac : IsPAC 𝒳 A ε δ) (hA : A.IsFixedBudget T)
    (θ : E) {Z : ℝ} (h0 : ∀ x ∈ 𝒳, 0 ≤ simpleRegret 𝒳 θ x) (hZ : ∀ x ∈ 𝒳, simpleRegret 𝒳 θ x ≤ Z)
    (hεZ : ε ≤ Z) :
    ∫ p, simpleRegret 𝒳 θ p.2 ∂(pairKernel A T θ) ≤ ε + (Z - ε) * δ
proof:
:= by
  exact integral_simpleRegret_le_of_measureReal_le (P := pairKernel A T θ) measurable_snd h0 hZ
    hεZ (hpac.le_measureReal_pairKernel hA θ)

name: Learning.LinearBandit.noiseHistLaw
doc: The law of the history of `T` rounds of `alg` under pure noise (`θ = 0`).

statement.value:
MeasureTheory.Measure.map (history IT.obs IT.action IT.feedback T)
  (trajMeasure alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 0))

code:
/-- The law of the history of `T` rounds of `alg` under pure noise (`θ = 0`). -/
noncomputable def noiseHistLaw (alg : Algorithm Unit 𝒳 ℝ) (T : ℕ) : Measure (Hist Unit 𝒳 ℝ T) :=
  (trajMeasure alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 0)).map (history IT.obs IT.action IT.feedback T)

/-- For any run of `A` under `θ`, (history of the `T` rounds, recommendation) has law

lemma _root_.Learning.IdentAlg.IsRun.hasLaw_history_out_pairKernel

name: Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hasLaw_history_histKernel

binders.name: h
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (LinearBandit.linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ) P

statement.conclusion: ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw (history O X Y T) ((LinearBandit.histKernel alg T) θ) P

code:
lemma _root_.Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.hasLaw_history_histKernel
    (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ) P) (T : ℕ) :
    HasLaw (history O X Y T) (histKernel alg T θ) P
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : Measurable (history O X Y T) := h.measurable_history T
  exact ⟨hfin.aemeasurable, h.map_history_eq_histKernel T⟩

name: Learning.LinearBandit.pairKernel
doc:
**The law of (history, recommendation) of the fixed-budget algorithm `A` under `θ`, as a
Markov kernel in `θ`**: the history kernel composed with the output rule.
code:
/-- **The law of (history, recommendation) of the fixed-budget algorithm `A` under `θ`, as a
Markov kernel in `θ`**: the history kernel composed with the output rule. -/
noncomputable def pairKernel (A : IdentAlg Unit 𝒳 ℝ 𝒳) (T : ℕ) :
    Kernel E (Hist Unit 𝒳 ℝ T × 𝒳) :=
  histKernel A.alg T ⊗ₖ (A.output.comap (Sigma.mk T) (measurable_sigma_mk T)).prodMkLeft E

name: Learning.LinearBandit.instIsMarkovKernelHistUnitElemRealHistKernel
code: instance (alg : Algorithm Unit 𝒳 ℝ) (T : ℕ) : IsMarkovKernel (histKernel (E := E) alg T)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun θ ↦ by
    rw [← (IT.isAlgEnvSeq_trajMeasure alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ)).map_history_eq_histKernel T]
    infer_instance⟩

code: instance (alg : Algorithm Unit 𝒳 ℝ) (T : ℕ) : IsProbabilityMeasure (noiseHistLaw alg T)

name: Learning.LinearBandit.pairKernel_apply

statement.conclusion: (pairKernel A T) θ = ((histKernel A.alg T) θ).compProd (A.output.comap (Sigma.mk T) ⋯)

code:
lemma pairKernel_apply (θ : E) :
    pairKernel A T θ =
      histKernel A.alg T θ ⊗ₘ A.output.comap (Sigma.mk T) (measurable_sigma_mk T)

name: Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.map_history_eq_histKernel
doc: The history of any algorithm-environment sequence under `θ` has law `histKernel alg T θ`.

binders.name: h
binders.type: IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (LinearBandit.linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ) P

statement.conclusion: MeasureTheory.Measure.map (history O X Y T) P = (LinearBandit.histKernel alg T) θ

code:
/-- The history of any algorithm-environment sequence under `θ` has law `histKernel alg T θ`. -/
lemma _root_.Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.map_history_eq_histKernel
    (h : IsAlgEnvSeq O X Y alg (linearGaussianEnv 𝒳 θ) P) (T : ℕ) :
    P.map (history O X Y T) = histKernel alg T θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [histKernel_apply, noiseHistLaw]
  exact h.map_history_eq_withDensity_likelihood (IT.isAlgEnvSeq_trajMeasure alg _) T

name: Learning.LinearBandit.histKernel_apply

statement.conclusion: (histKernel alg T) θ = (noiseHistLaw alg T).withDensity fun h => ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood θ h)

code:
lemma histKernel_apply (alg : Algorithm Unit 𝒳 ℝ) (T : ℕ) (θ : E) :
    histKernel alg T θ =
      (noiseHistLaw alg T).withDensity fun h ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood θ h)

name: Learning.LinearBandit.histKernel
doc:
**The law of the history under `θ` as a Markov kernel in `θ`**: the pure-noise law with
density `likelihood θ`.

statement.value:
(ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const E (noiseHistLaw alg T)).withDensity fun θ h =>
  ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood θ h)

code:
/-- **The law of the history under `θ` as a Markov kernel in `θ`**: the pure-noise law with
density `likelihood θ`. -/
noncomputable def histKernel (alg : Algorithm Unit 𝒳 ℝ) (T : ℕ) : Kernel E (Hist Unit 𝒳 ℝ T) :=
  Kernel.withDensity (Kernel.const E (noiseHistLaw alg T))
    fun θ h ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood θ h)

name: Learning.LinearBandit.measurable_uncurry_ofReal_likelihood

statement.conclusion: Measurable (Function.uncurry fun θ h => ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood θ h))

lemma measurable_uncurry_ofReal_likelihood (T : ℕ) :

      ENNReal.ofReal (likelihood θ h))
